instruction:
Compile the reported interaction classes for exact ingredient pairs between the drug groups "Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI)" and "MAO inhibitor" (also named "Monoamine oxidase inhibitors"). Return a complete table for a medication-transition records review.

Use current public records accessed from 2026-09-11T16:26:15.871Z (inclusive) to 2026-09-13T16:26:15.871Z (exclusive).

Include every leaf drug entry identified by a D number from each of the two complete official group records, including all nested branches. Keep different D numbers separate, including salts and hydrates. Do not filter members by country tags or by whether they are commonly used as antidepressants.

Include a pair when one member belongs to the SSRI group, the other belongs to the MAO inhibitor group, and at least one of CI or P is reported for that exact pair. Exclude pairs within either group. A report in either orientation counts; combine the two orientations into one pair.

CI means the source reports a contraindication. P means it reports a precaution. Preserve every reported class: use CI,P when both are reported.

Omit a pair only when complete, successful coverage contains no reported interaction for it. Absence does not establish clinical safety. If access failures or unresolved source conflicts prevent a complete determination, describe the limitation in the separate evidence field and do not present an incomplete table as complete.

To carry out the review:
1. Identify all leaf D numbers in both group records.
2. Obtain interaction records covering every cross-group pair. Check both orientations where necessary to resolve gaps.
3. Combine the reported classes for each exact cross-group pair and sort the complete result.
output_format: Put only a pipe-separated table in the answer field, with the header ssri_id|mao_id|classes. Use exact D numbers without the dr: prefix; names are not required. Put the SSRI member first and the MAO inhibitor member second. Write one row per distinct ingredient pair. The classes value must be CI, P, or CI,P. Sort rows by ssri_id, then mao_id, both ascending. Include every qualifying pair; there is no row limit. If successful complete coverage finds no qualifying pairs, write the header followed by a single line NONE. In the separate evidence field, provide public evidence URLs, actual UTC access dates, and any relevant revision dates supplied by the source; say unavailable when a revision is not supplied. Put any access limitations or unresolved source conflicts in that field as well.
